items.title: HP Stock Drops After PC Maker Forecasts Industry Sales Decline
items.summary: HPQ stock fell Monday after HP forecast industrywide personal computer sales will decline by mid-single digits next year.

items.title: Is Apple Stock's Shrinking Share Count Worth Paying Up For Near The Highs?
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) stock has gained 41.2% over the past twelve months and trades near its 52-week high of $339.79. All the while, Apple keeps buying back its own shares, so each share you hold claims a bigger slice of the profit. That engine is real and well funded, but at 38.2 times trailing earnings it explains only a small part of what you are now paying for.

items.title: HP Inc. Warns of Extended PC Market Slump. The Stock Is Tumbling.

items.title: HP Shares Fall 2% as Company Anticipates PC Market Contraction in 2027
items.summary: HP Inc. (NYSE:HPQ) shares declined 2% in Monday morning trading after the company disclosed that it expects worldwide personal computer shipments to fall in calendar 2027.

items.title: HP shares slide as tech giant forecasts 2027 PC market slump
items.summary: Investing.com -- HP Inc. (NYSE: HPQ) shares stumbled 2% in Monday morning trading after the company delivered a sobering reality check for the personal computer industry. In a fresh SEC filing, the Palo Alto heavyweight cautioned that it expects global PC unit volumes to shrink by mid-single digits in calendar 2027 compared to 2026.
